lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines identified on the primary torso mass; spacing is non-uniform, with higher density and narrower inter-line pixel distance occurring towards the posterior third of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 7th line segment from the anterior shoulder; lines 4 and 5 converge near the spinal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (anterior) and Line 11 (posterior) are truncated, terminating at approximately 40% of the total dorso-ventral torso height.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 3 high-contrast circular spots located on the upper posterior haunch, positioned approximately mid-way between the spinal ridge and the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking at the base of the neck; white supraorbital and infraorbital spots present; distinct white 'stocking' markings on the lower distal limbs above the hooves.
